rows.operation: AAIB Annual Safety Review 2025 parcel-attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Occurrence notifications, investigations and safety actions provide national aviation-safety context; they are not airport, flight-path or parcel-specific hazard measurements.

rows.operation: RAIB Annual Report 2025 parcel-attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: National notification, examination and investigation totals support rail-safety calibration only; they cannot be attributed to an exact property or nearby railway segment without case-level evidence.

rows.operation: MCA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 parcel-attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Agency strategy, KPI and governance reporting is held as institutional context and is not independent evidence of marine risk at a coast, port or parcel.

rows.operation: MAIB current investigations register parcel-attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: The register identifies investigations and preliminary assessments, not established causation or generalised local risk; open cases must not be converted into parcel scores.
